title: Darkness to Dawn
description: a steampunk medieval adventure meant to be played with your friends as you fight off waves of zombies
body:
gather together with your friends or enemies, maybe both but its whatever you prefer, and survive against hordes of zombies wether that be in an airship, in a village, or in a vehicle, the imagination is your only limit. this mod is focused around a brass knight theme (steampunk darkages). there will be a community server that will be avilable in socials tied to this project at a later date.

included content: Epic knights (plus addons that are currently on 1.21.1), create, create: aeroanutics, Train content for create, and many dimensional adventures. 

theme: adventure, survival, multiplayer!
